headline_marked: [[Woman stabbed to death]] in Rajshahi over land dispute; suspect's house torched
headline: Woman stabbed to death in Rajshahi over land dispute; suspect's house torched
summary: Farida Parveen (35) succumbed to stab wounds after a dispute, leading to an angry mob setting fire to the alleged killer's house in Rajshahi.
details: Farida Parveen, 35, was fatally stabbed in Rajshahi on Friday night following a land dispute. The incident occurred around 8:30 PM, leading to her immediate unconsciousness due to severe blood loss.

Locals reported that the dispute was between Parash and Farida's family over land. A physical altercation escalated, during which Parash allegedly attacked Farida with a knife, striking her in the throat.
Farida was rushed to the emergency department of Rajshahi Medical College Hospital, where doctors pronounced her dead. Her body has been transferred to the hospital morgue for further procedures.
Following the murder, an enraged crowd retaliated by setting fire to the house of Parash, the accused. Parash, identified as the son of Babu from the Harian area, fled the scene after the incident.

Rajshahi Metropolitan Police (RMP) spokesperson Deputy Commissioner Md. Gaziur Rahman confirmed the death of Farida and stated that police are present in the area. Further details regarding the investigation are expected to be released soon.

headline_marked: [[Residential Medical Officer arrested with 50 Yaba pills]] in Narsingdi
headline: Residential Medical Officer arrested with 50 Yaba pills in Narsingdi
summary: Dr. Ismail Al Rajib, RMO of Raipura Upazila Health Complex, was apprehended with 50 Yaba pills during an anti-drug operation. Police confirmed he admitted to consuming Yaba.
details: Dr. Ismail Al Rajib, the Residential Medical Officer (RMO) of Raipura Upazila Health Complex, was arrested with 50 Yaba pills. He was apprehended on Friday evening (July 24) from Tulatali Mor in the upazila.
Raipura Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Mujibur Rahman confirmed the arrest, stating it was part of a regular anti-drug operation. During a body search, 50 Yaba tablets were seized from him.
The OC also mentioned that Dr. Rajib initially admitted to police that he consumed Yaba. Preparations are underway to file a regular case against him.
